full_judgment: 3. The defendant Nos. 1 and 2 have appeared and contested in the suit by filing written statement denying all allegations made in the plaint. The case of the defendants is that, the defendants have purchased the suit property in auction sale and the said sale was confirmed and a boinama was prepared in their manes. The plaintiff was evicted from the suit property as per provision of section 167 of the BT Act and thereafter the suit property has become under the khas possession of the defendants and since then the defendants were occupying the suit property for last 45 years. The further case of the defendant is that, the plaintiff was not tenant under them and they also pleaded that the suit was barred by limitation and that there was no cause of action to file this suit.
